name: Prayer Public
overview: Scripture presents public prayer as a solemn and heartfelt act before God, exemplified by Joshua who humbled himself with the elders before the ark, expressing deep concern and dependence on the Lord in times of crisis. David's public blessing of the Lord before the congregation highlights the communal and worshipful nature of such prayer, acknowledging God's eternal sovereignty. These examples underscore that public prayer is both a means to seek God's guidance and blessing and an expression of reverence and trust in His name.
